newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo Nikkei fall excessive, insurers' leader says.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo Nikkei fall excessive, insurers' leader says.

text.p: A fall of the key Nikkei 225 average of shares on the first section of the Tokyo Stock Exchange was excessive, Life Insurance Association of Japan chairman Kenjiro Hata told a news conference on Friday.
Tokyo stocks tumbled to their lowest level in a year on Thursday, with the benchmark Nikkei dipping below the 20,000 level to close down 522.36 at 19,570.67 points.
Hata said stock prices in the business year starting next April 1 may be not bright because corporate earnings are not showing a dramatic recovery.
The index may move just above 20,000, he said, adding that foreign investors may buy Japanese shares at the start of the next business year.
